title: Plux analytics: page and plugin usage, funnels
description: Screen views per page, events per plugin and funnel step volumes (ANL-020).

list.name: organization
list.label: Organisation ID
list.description: The organisation UUID. Row-level security binds every query to it (SRV-022).

list.name: app
list.label: App
list.description: The apps of the organisation with rollups.

list.name: release
list.label: Release sequence
list.description: The release sequences of the selected apps with rollups.

list.name: funnel
list.label: Funnel steps
list.description: Comma-separated page or event names, in funnel order.

panels.title: Screen views by page
panels.description: Screen views per page over time.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT set_config('plux.organization_id', '$organization', false);
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(r.bucket, $__interval), r.page AS metric, SUM(r.events) AS value
FROM analytics_rollups r
WHERE r.organization_id = NULLIF('$organization', '')::uuid
  AND r.granularity = '$granularity'
  AND $__timeFilter(r.bucket)
  AND r.app_id::text IN ($app)
  AND r.release_sequence::text IN ($release)
  AND r.event_name = 'screen_view'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Top pages
panels.description: Screen views per page in the range. Capped at 100 rows.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT set_config('plux.organization_id', '$organization', false);
SELECT r.page AS "Page", SUM(r.events) AS "Events"
FROM analytics_rollups r
WHERE r.organization_id = NULLIF('$organization', '')::uuid
  AND r.granularity = '$granularity'
  AND $__timeFilter(r.bucket)
  AND r.app_id::text IN ($app)
  AND r.release_sequence::text IN ($release)
  AND r.event_name = 'screen_view'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 100;

panels.title: Plugin usage
panels.description: Events per plugin in the range, with screen views. Events with no plugin are left out.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT set_config('plux.organization_id', '$organization', false);
SELECT r.plugin_key AS "Plugin", SUM(r.events) FILTER (WHERE r.event_name = 'screen_view') AS "Screen views",
  SUM(r.events) AS "Events"
FROM analytics_rollups r
WHERE r.organization_id = NULLIF('$organization', '')::uuid
  AND r.granularity = '$granularity'
  AND $__timeFilter(r.bucket)
  AND r.app_id::text IN ($app)
  AND r.release_sequence::text IN ($release)
  AND r.plugin_key <> ''
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 3 DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT set_config('plux.organization_id', '$organization', false);
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(r.bucket, $__interval), r.plugin_key AS metric, SUM(r.events) AS value
FROM analytics_rollups r
WHERE r.organization_id = NULLIF('$organization', '')::uuid
  AND r.granularity = '$granularity'
  AND $__timeFilter(r.bucket)
  AND r.app_id::text IN ($app)
  AND r.release_sequence::text IN ($release)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Funnel
panels.description: Ordered steps from the Funnel steps variable. Each step counts the events named after it, or the screen views of that page. The counts are events, not users, and the order is not checked per user, so a step can exceed the one before it.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT set_config('plux.organization_id', '$organization', false);
WITH steps AS (
  SELECT btrim(s.name) AS name, s.ord
  FROM unnest(string_to_array('$funnel', ',')) WITH ORDINALITY AS s(name, ord)
), counts AS (
  SELECT st.ord, st.name, SUM(r.events) AS events
  FROM steps st
  LEFT JOIN analytics_rollups r
    ON r.organization_id = NULLIF('$organization', '')::uuid
    AND r.granularity = '$granularity'
    AND $__timeFilter(r.bucket)
    AND r.app_id::text IN ($app)
    AND r.release_sequence::text IN ($release)
    AND (r.event_name = st.name OR (r.event_name = 'screen_view' AND r.page = st.name))
  GROUP BY st.ord, st.name
)
SELECT ord AS "Step", name AS "Page or event", COALESCE(events, 0) AS "Events",
  100.0 * COALESCE(events, 0) / NULLIF(FIRST_VALUE(events) OVER (ORDER BY ord), 0) AS "Of step 1 (%)"
FROM counts
ORDER BY ord;
